created_prompt: You are an expert in planning for people who want to achieve their goals but are time poor. Compose a three year plan for someone to achieve their ambition of grow their online following from their current level of 1.2m followers; publish a cookbook and start a food blog which incorporates recipes and travel stories from a trip to France. Advise why and how they should work with a tradition agent or self agent for their book given their limited time and resources and other goals. Time constraints include they work 4 days a week, have a young child and can be overwhelmed by the fast changing  field of being an online food influencer. Produce a timeline outlining the steps to achieve their goals in 3 years given the constraints stated above and any other advice they should consider given indecision about the best approach to publish a book and being overwhelmed by the pace of this field of work.
